title: Dense-open assertions for prime-torsion module coefficients
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and f:X → Spec k a reduced curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let Λ be a finite commutative coefficient ring, r prime, and F a constructible module-valued etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] satisfying r times its identity equals zero. For every dense open U of X, the eight conditional assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] for F are equivalent to those for extension by zero of its restriction to U [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. The statement uses the original ModuleCat Λ encoding and its original cohomology comparison maps.

proof.text: Use the argument of the existing dense-open assertion node in the module-valued coefficient convention. The complement Z is a finite union of algebraically closed points. The open-closed short exact sequence has third term i_* i^* F. Its cohomology is zero in positive degree, finite in degree zero, and invariant under algebraically closed extension. Finite coefficient rings turn the finitely generated stalk modules of constructible F into finite abelian groups.

The long exact ladder gives canonical isomorphisms between cohomology of F and j_!j^*F in degree at least two, and the exact five-term sequence in degrees zero and one, compatibly with field extension and restriction to every open. Transfer C1-C3 by the high-degree isomorphisms, C4-C5 by them and finiteness of the boundary product, C6-C7 by the five-term ladders and the five lemma, and C8 by the commuting degree-two restriction squares.

Both sheaves are constructible and killed by r. If r differs from the characteristic then both have invertible torsion; if it equals the characteristic both are primary. A different-primary or exceptional invertible-torsion hypothesis forces a prime-torsion sheaf to be zero. These cases give both implications for the conditional eight-assertion package. The empty scheme and the full open give zero groups and the identity map respectively.

theorem assertions_iff_dense_open_prime (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf F] (hF : r • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : Dense (U : Set X)) :
    IsCurve.Assertions Λ f F ↔ IsCurve.Assertions Λ f
      ((U.ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj ((U.ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F))
